svg.text: The shared field editor — one table, two modes, substructures; hosts differ only by settings (design §6)
Scope: the table and its popups. Window chrome and the hosts' other sections are context — unchanged.
Params — AmbushParams (a params asset, CE-3376 — the generic form)
DEFINE mode — the author declares the fields; Default is the value a new user of the type starts from.
'max range' is not a name — letters, digits and _ only
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y · double-click a name to rename · drag ⋮⋮ to move
A structure row shows a summary
A structure is a NAMED type (D1):
its fields here are the type's —
Details — AI — Ambush (FILL mode: values for one unit)
FILL mode — names and types are fixed (grey); every value is the default until changed. A closed structure says what changed.
Reset all = the ⋮ of the section.
Details — Scenario — Parameters (DEFINE + the preset's values)
(presets design §5a — the combo, + and ⋮ are drawn there)
flat: no ▸ rows — the Type list offers no structures or lists
Structures and lists are off for
The same picker for every host; a group the host's settings forbid
is shown greyed with the reason, never hidden (§5a of AQ108: gates
One table · the hosts differ ONLY by these settings
Columns: Default · Value · Live · Bytes · UsedBy
